ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% low-intensity (black) and 30% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region localized on the left lateral lobe from mid-wing to tip, bisected by dark linear striations. Fragmented high-intensity regions localized on the distal half of the right lateral lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serration pattern. The right lobe features a prominent deep macro-notch (large semi-circular excision) approximately 60% distal from the midline. Left lobe shows moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical upward convex sweep; the right lobe exhibits a more acute vertical curvature at the terminal tip compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-intensity circular pixel clusters (3-5 distinct points) located at the extreme distal terminals of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 6-8 distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity field on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural anomaly on the trailing edge of the right lobe consisting of a large, deep semi-circular excision or healed trauma site.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, dendritic pigmentation boundary between the central low-intensity zone and lateral high-intensity zones on both lobes.
